title: Files That Follow You
tagline: Build your real cloud vault — done before Lesson 3.
objectives: I can build my real folder system in Google Drive and find it from any device.
I know OneDrive and Google Drive are two separate cloud stores, and which kind of work lives in each.
I can create, save and re-open a file in the cloud.

config.headline: Files that follow you.
lines: In Mission Control you filed pretend files into a pretend Vault.
This side quest is the real thing: you'll build your actual folders, in your actual cloud, and HQ will inspect the result.
Twenty minutes, any device, any time — but have it done before Lesson 3.
Two clouds, one agent. Let's set them both up.

config.intro: Google Drive is the cloud that follows your C2k login to ANY device — school, home, even a phone. Time to build your Vault in it, for real.

steps.title: Open your real Drive
steps.text: Open a new tab and go to drive.google.com — on a school computer it signs you in by itself. At home, sign in with your C2k email (yourusername@c2ken.net).

steps.title: Create your School folder
steps.text: Click + New (top-left) → New folder. Name it exactly: School — capital S, nothing else. This is the top of your filing system, just like the Vault.

steps.title: Create DT Work inside School
steps.text: Open your School folder (double-click it), then + New → New folder again. Name this one exactly: DT Work. Everything you make in DT lives here — and your DT teacher can find it when you share it.

steps.title: Put your first real file in it
steps.text: Inside DT Work: + New → Google Docs. A blank document opens — type your codename, then close the tab. No save button needed: Google Docs saves to the cloud as you type.
steps.confirm: My first file is in DT Work

config.intro: Talk is cheap, Agent. HQ will now look inside your actual Google Drive and check the Vault is really there.

checks.label: A folder named School in My Drive
A folder named DT Work inside School

config.passText: Inspection PASSED. Your Vault is real, and it will follow you to every device you ever sign in on.
config.failText: Not there yet — that's fixable in under a minute. Check the exact names and try the inspection again.

config.intro: Here's the twist: your C2k login comes with TWO clouds. OneDrive is Microsoft's — it's where Word, Excel and PowerPoint work lives for lots of your other subjects. Same idea as Drive, different building.

steps.title: Open your OneDrive
steps.text: Log into My-School, the way you do every day. In the Launch panel, click Microsoft 365 Web Apps. When it opens, click the squares menu in the very top-left corner and choose OneDrive.

steps.title: Build a School folder here too
steps.text: Click + New → Folder and name it exactly: School. Now both of your clouds have the same tidy top level — future-you will be very grateful.

steps.title: Know which cloud is which
steps.text: The rule of thumb: Word / Excel / PowerPoint work → OneDrive. Google Docs and everything you make in DT → Google Drive. They are two SEPARATE places — a file saved in one is not in the other.
steps.confirm: I know which cloud my work goes in

config.intro: One scenario before the side quest closes.

items.stem: You typed an essay in Word Online for English, and made a quiz in Google Docs for DT. Which is TRUE?
options: The essay is in OneDrive and the quiz is in Google Drive — two separate clouds
Both files are in the same place, because it's the same login
The files copy themselves between the two clouds overnight
Neither is saved unless you clicked a save button

statements: I can open my Google Drive from any device.
I built my School and DT Work folders for real.
I know OneDrive and Google Drive are two different clouds.
